comment: With architecture fixed, optimizer progress was the main discriminator at this short budget. C’s AdamW rate supported more learning than D’s; B’s low-rate RMSprop was competitive without entering the high-rate caution regime. E’s momentum SGD remained viable but slower on this deep GELU network, while A’s tiny Adagrad rate implied very limited progress. K1001, K1002, K1019, and K1070 helped. The correct ordering adds one supporting instance, not a universal displacement or optimizer-family ranking; no new tested hypothesis emerged.
